svg.desc: One DP-SGD step: compute per-example gradients, clip each to L2 norm at most C, sum them, add Gaussian noise with standard deviation sigma times C, then average and take a step. A circle of radius C shows a long gradient cut back to the boundary while short ones are unchanged. Noise on the mean gradient is sigma C over n.

svg.text: (ε, δ)-DP: P[A(D) ∈ S] ≤ e^ε · P[A(D′) ∈ S] + δ for datasets differing in one record

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: C = 1, σ = 2, n = 256: noise std on the mean gradient = 2 · 1 / 256 ≈ 0.0078 per coordinate. ε comes from an accountant (σ, sampling rate, steps).
